messages:
prashant: brief: customers seeing sudden quality cliffs when we cascade fp8->int8 in sessions. thinking a small admit + grace tokens flow to smooth. quick opinions?

eva: yes. prefer edge-local grace + tenant credits. keep default no-downgrade unless opt-in.

sam: agree. propose headers `X-Precision-Preference` and `X-Quality-Budget`. add optional /admit for large requests.

leo: add session stickiness: `X-Session-Id`. avoid flipping precision within cooldown window (e.g., 30s or 500 tokens).

maya: ops: emit `precision.admit_denied`, `precision.grace_used`, `precision.token_share_by_bitwidth`. also shadow-sample 1% of downgrades to calibrate debit values.

prashant: ok responsibilities: SDK surfaces headers + optional admit call; edge enforces grace; runtime manages credits + reconcile. I'll write a short RFC.

eva: add canary rule: new fp8 profiles start with grace=0 and require explicit admit.force for first 24h.

prashant: actionable: @sam add SDK helper, @maya add metrics panels, @leo draft cooldown/hysteresis pseudo. reconvene Wed. thanks :thumbsup:
